notes: Official Roblox game-pass data confirms four aura-named passes and current Robux prices.
Public guide and fan-wiki sources support Auras as passive speed bonuses that stack with other speed systems, but they do not provide per-aura multipliers.
No source checked in Phase 2 confirmed exact per-aura effects or multipliers, so each row keeps effect as Not verified.
Current public copy should describe the known Aura rows as Robux game-pass sourced unless a separate in-game Wins aura route is later verified.
